item.title: Grok spreads misinformation (again) about Bondi beach shooting
item.description: Grok says it was actually an old clip of a man trimming a palm tree in a parking lot.

item.title: Reddit sues Australia over teens’ social media ban
item.description: Reddit’s lawsuit argues the ban barely reduces harm, since most Reddit content is publicly viewable without an account anyway.

item.title: US government websites are hosting porn, malware, and sex toys
item.description: Officials say attackers abused user-upload tools, like a group calendar, to sneak in AI-generated porn.

item.title: This AI toy tucks kids in and lectures them on geopolitics
item.description: Some of the toys are also pushing political talking points straight from Beijing.

item.title: Roomba maker iRobot goes bust post-Amazon deal disaster
item.description: iRobot is turning the page as it files for bankruptcy protection, handing the reins to its Chinese manufacturing partner. The company faces fierce competition and tariff challenges.

item.title: Google Translate just got way smarter and works on all your earbuds now
item.description: Google's Gemini AI is not just translating—it's transforming communication across 70+ languages in real-time. With its expansion to 20 new countries, language learning is getting a major upgrade.

item.title: Apple’s Photos app bug adds a bloody twist to Android pics
item.description: Apple's Photos app is getting a quirky makeover, as Android photos appear with a "horrifying red filter" on iPhone.

item.title: Apple AirTags bundle drops to $75 at Amazon (limited-time only)
item.description: Amazon has dropped the price of Apple's AirTags 4-pack to $75, the lowest price available, making it an attractive offer for those looking to keep track of their keys, wallet, luggage, and more.

item.title: Limited offer: Bose QuietComfort headphones, now $199 (43% OFF)
item.description: Bose QuietComfort Headphones, renowned for their superior noise-canceling capabilities, are currently on sale for $199, a $130 savings from their usual retail price.

item.title: Apple’s first “wide” iPhone fold ditches Face ID to stay stupid thin
item.description: Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone is set to redefine sleekness and strength, with a book-style design, expansive display, and side-mounted Touch ID.
